description: Implementation of a simple linked list data structure with functions for creation, cloning, destruction, insertion, deletion, searching, iteration, and iterator management. Contains internal classes and functions for list nodes and iterator handling, with external references to list and linked list types.

classes.name: _icLinkedListIterator
classes.description: Structure modeling a linked list iterator, maintaining current, previous nodes, and the list being iterated.

methods.name: linkedListCreate
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new linked list object.

methods.name: linkedListClone
methods.description: Creates a shallow clone of an existing linked list; items are not owned by the clone.

methods.name: linkedListDeepClone
methods.description: Creates a deep clone of an existing linked list using a provided item cloning function.

methods.name: linkedListDestroy
methods.description: Destroys a linked list and frees associated memory, optionally freeing list items with a helper function.

methods.name: linkedListIsClone
methods.description: Checks if a list was created via linkedListClone.

methods.name: standardDoNotFreeFunc
methods.description: A helper function that does not free list items; used when items should not be freed.

methods.name: linkedListCount
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the list.

methods.name: linkedListAppend
methods.description: Appends an item to the end of the list.

methods.name: linkedListPrepend
methods.description: Prepends an item to the beginning of the list.

methods.name: linkedListFind
methods.description: Searches for an item in the list using a comparison function.

methods.name: linkedListRemove
methods.description: Removes and returns the item at a specified offset.

methods.name: linkedListDelete
methods.description: Deletes an item matching a search value, optionally freeing the item.

methods.name: linkedListIterate
methods.description: Iterates over list items, calling a callback function for each.

methods.name: linkedListGetElementAt
methods.description: Retrieves the element at a specific index without removing it.

methods.name: linkedListClear
methods.description: Clears all items from the list, freeing memory as needed.

methods.name: linkedListIteratorCreate
methods.description: Creates an iterator for traversing the list.

methods.name: linkedListIteratorDestroy
methods.description: Destroys a list iterator and frees memory.

methods.name: linkedListIteratorHasNext
methods.description: Checks if the iterator has more items.

methods.name: linkedListIteratorGetNext
methods.description: Retrieves the next item in the list via the iterator.

methods.name: linkedListStringCompareFunc
methods.description: Compares a string search value with list item strings.

methods.name: linkedListCloneStringItemFunc
methods.description: Clones string items for deep copying lists of strings.

methods.name: linkedListIteratorDeleteCurrent
methods.description: Deletes the current item pointed to by the iterator.
